name: repository-review
goal: Review the repository, verify the important findings, and produce one implementation plan.

tasks.title: Architecture review
tasks.prompt: Map the architecture. Find the highest-risk boundaries.

tasks.title: Correctness review
tasks.prompt: Find concrete correctness defects. Include file and line evidence.

tasks.title: Independent review
tasks.prompt: Audit the same repository independently. Challenge weak assumptions.

tasks.title: Synthesize the review
tasks.prompt: Reconcile the prior findings. Remove duplicates. Rank the required work.
